subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配体分类：下列配体属于哪一种 L/X 类型：nitrosyl, linear（NO）？
A. LX
B. X₃
C. L₂
D. L₂X₂
explanation: NO (nitrosyl, linear) is an LX ligand: each L gives 2 electrons and each X one, so 3 electrons in the covalent count (2 in the ionic count).
